title: A Special Christmas Morning
content:
It is Christmas morning, and Emma is very excited. She wakes up early and runs to the living room.

— My presents are under the tree! — she says.

Her brother, Tom, is also happy. His favorite gift is a new toy train.

Their parents prepare breakfast in the kitchen. Their family loves spending Christmas together.

Emma gives her mother a small gift.

— This is for you — she says. Her mother's smile is beautiful.

Tom shows his father his new train.

— Look at my train! Do you like its colors?

Later, the family opens Santa's presents. Everyone thanks each other for their gifts.

At the end of the day, Emma says:

— Christmas is special because of our family and our love.

Everyone agrees. It is their favorite day of the year.
